questions.q: What correction finally resolves the AP accrual problem?
options: Deleting INV-MER-88341 entirely
Increasing the supplier's payment terms to Net 60
Reclassifying the PO to a different cost center
A manual reversing journal, JE-REV-0131, debiting Accrued Liabilities and crediting Inventory clearing for $18,400.00
questions.explain: JE-REV-0131 does manually what the original auto-reverse flag should have done automatically, clearing the stale $18,400.00 accrual.

questions.q: How is the Harborview AR problem corrected?
options: By writing off INV-HV-29890's balance entirely
By unapplying RCPT-50231 from INV-HV-29890 and reapplying it in full to INV-HV-30144
By creating a brand-new receipt for $55,100.00
By merging the two invoices into one
questions.explain: The receipt is unapplied from the wrong invoice and reapplied to the correct one, restoring accurate open-item detail on both invoices.

questions.q: What is notable about how the $9,200.00 bank variance gets resolved?
options: It requires a correcting journal entry in the GL
It is resolved by writing off the difference as a loss
It requires no GL correction at all — only the bank's written confirmation and reversal of its duplicate debit
It requires reversing PMT-21094 instead of PMT-21087
questions.explain: Because the GL was correct all along, the fix is entirely on the bank's side: Regions Bank confirms and reverses the duplicate transmission.

questions.q: What two actions resolve the Subledger Accounting problem with the 14 Incomplete transactions?
options: Adding the missing Account Rule mapping for account 7850, then rerunning Create Accounting
Deleting the transactions and re-entering them manually
Changing the transaction type from Freight Charge to Miscellaneous
Waiving the accounting requirement for freight transactions
questions.explain: Once the Account Rule is updated to map account 7850, rerunning Create Accounting successfully generates and posts accounting for all 14 transactions.

questions.q: What must be confirmed across every subledger before period Jan-26 can actually close?
options: That every supplier has a preferred flag set
That each subledger (Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management) reconciles to its GL control account
That the Canadian ledger has been deleted
That no further transactions will ever be entered for this company
questions.explain: Victor Okafor confirms every subledger reconciles to its GL control account and reruns the trial balance before formally closing the period in both ledgers.
